battle-shout.summary: Bonus Action: allies within 30 ft who hear you add the die to damage on their next melee hit before your next turn starts.
battle-shout.duration: until the start of your next turn

demoralizing-shout.summary: Bonus Action: enemies within 30 ft who hear you subtract the die from damage on their next melee hit against anyone but you, until your next turn ends.
demoralizing-shout.duration: until the end of your next turn

heroic-leap.summary: Bonus Action: jump up to your Strength score in feet; creatures within 5 ft where you land make a STR save, taking the die roll in Bludgeoning damage, half on a success.

mortal-strike.summary: On a hit, add the die to damage; the target can't regain HP until your next turn ends.
mortal-strike.duration: until the end of your next turn

warding-maneuver.summary: Reaction when you or a creature you see within 5 ft is hit, while holding a Melee weapon or Shield: add the die to the target's AC against it; if it still hits, the target resists its damage.
